import React, { useState, useEffect } from 'react'; import { Link } from 'react-router-dom'; import { useAuth } from '../context/AuthContext'; import { getDashboardStats } from '../services/dashboardService'; import { Search, PlusCircle, Sparkles, ShieldCheck, Bell, Clock, ArrowRight, MapPin, TrendingUp, } from 'lucide-react'; import LoadingSpinner from '../components/LoadingSpinner'; const DashboardPage = () => { const { user } = useAuth(); const [stats, setStats] = useState(null); const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true); useEffect(() => { const fetchStats = async () => { try { const data = await getDashboardStats(); setStats(data); } catch (err) { console.error("Dashboard stats error:", err); } finally { setLoading(false); } }; fetchStats(); }, []); if (loading) return ; const summary = stats?.summary || {}; return (
{/* Welcome Banner */}

Hello, {user?.first_name || user?.username}! 👋

Here is what's happening with your reported items, potential AI matches, and ownership claims.

Report Lost Report Found
{/* Metrics Row */}
My Lost Reports

{summary.my_lost_items || 0}

My Found Reports

{summary.my_found_items || 0}

AI Matches

{summary.my_matches || 0}

Claims Active

{(summary.claims_submitted || 0) + (summary.claims_received || 0)}

{/* Main Grid: Recent Activity & Quick Navigation */}
{/* Recent Items Box */}

Your Reported Items

Manage All Reports
{stats?.recent_items?.lost?.length === 0 && stats?.recent_items?.found?.length === 0 ? (

You haven't reported any lost or found items yet.

Report Lost Report Found
) : (
{stats?.recent_items?.lost?.map((item) => (
LOST {item.item_name} Reported {new Date(item.created_at).toLocaleDateString()}
{item.status} Details
))} {stats?.recent_items?.found?.map((item) => (
FOUND {item.item_name} Reported {new Date(item.created_at).toLocaleDateString()}
{item.status} Details
))}
)}
{/* Quick Tools Box */}

AI Matching Engine

Our multimodal CLIP AI compares your item images and geolocations against all submitted records.

View My Matches

Ownership Claims

Review claims submitted on items you found or check status of claims you filed.

Manage Claims

Map Exploration

Locate items near you using radius and coordinate search on OpenStreetMap.

Open Live Map
); }; export default DashboardPage;
